Rita (Billing): FYI found a handful of March invoices with VAT duplicated when reserved_capacity credits apply. Some ended up with negative final balances.
Omar (Eng): Job id?
Rita (Billing): invoice-run-2026-03-24-04. Snippet:
```
- reserved_capacity_credit: -100.00
- usage_compute: 100.00
- vat: 0.00
- vat: 20.00
```
Rita (Billing): Looks like credits are zeroing tax in one service path and tax-service still emits VAT for gross path.
billing-bot: invoice-run-2026-03-24-04 completed: 16 warnings, 3 errors (TAX_DUPLICATE, EXPORT_BLOCKED).
Ben (Payments): Stripe will likely reject negatives and create draft churn. Recommend pause exports for that run.
Omar (Eng): I'll add an exporter guard to block invoices with negative totals and mark them for manual review. Quick dedupe by tax_code before finalize.
Zoe (RevOps): We need CSV of affected invoice ids and owners for sales/customer outreach.
Rita (Billing): I'll compile the list. Preliminary: 9 EU customers, 2 enterprise. Target notify within 24h, remediate in 48h.
Ben (Payments): After patch, we'll re-export only affected invoices; Stripe idempotency helps but drafts may need manual cleanup.
Omar (Eng): Root cause likely race between apply_credits and calculate_taxes. Long-term: single-source tax calc on final net lines; short-term: dedupe and assert total==sum(lines)+sum(taxes).
Rita (Billing): Holding the March exports now. I'll post draft customer message in ~2h. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
